name: Hardgroove
key_tendency: Minor or no key at all: one low note, the tonality lives in the tuned toms and the rim.
signature: Looped percussion: toms, rims and claps locked into a 1-bar groove
Tom and rim rolls that double up every 4 bars
Very little melody, a short rumbly bass at most
Long mixes: change one layer at a time
listen_for: The groove comes from the interlocking toms and rims, not from a melody. Listen for the fills doubling up at the end of each 4-bar phrase.

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [8, stack(drums, perc)],
  [16, stack(drums, hats, perc, bass)],
  [8, stack(hats, perc.lpf(1500))],
  [16, stack(drums, hats, perc, bass, fx)],
  [8, stack(drums, perc)],
)
